quotes.text: The account UI asks whether to include the identity email, then passes that email or an empty string to nsICertGen.gen. The C++ code adds an RFC 822 subject alternative name only when email is nonempty. The request subject itself is empty. Review caught a checkbox state error introduced by the back loop; the author corrected it and reported checking both checkbox states. For future changes, test both resulting CSR forms and the back path. This study did not execute the UI.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
